_comment: The schema documentation, and the no-op default. This file matches nothing:
an empty `match` block is never selected, so shipping it changes no parse.
Copy it to <vendor>.json, fill in `match`, and override only the boxes whose
labels that vendor prints differently from the IRS form.

_schema.match.producer: regex tested against the PDF's /Producer string (case-insensitive)
_schema.match.creator: regex tested against the PDF's /Creator string (case-insensitive)
_schema.doc_type: optional; when set, the template only applies to that registry doc type
_schema.box_patterns: {box_id: [regex, ...]} — replaces doc_types.py patterns for that box
_schema.value_side: 'right' (value follows the label on the same line) or 'below' (value sits under the label's column)
